description: List the CUSTOM TABLES an extension registers (table name + typed columns), so generated code can read/write its data at runtime via renderClient.getCustomTableData / upsertCustomTableData by table name (ground the calls with lookup_command_frame). Only the org's OWN extensions expose their tables — a public / other-org extension returns an empty list with a note. Pass the extension's id from list_extensions; the org's non-extension tables come from list_custom_tables. Read-only. Does not write files.

extensionId.description: The extension's id (the `id` from a list_extensions result).

hubToken.description: Organization JWT fallback, only if the hub rejects your API key for this route.

name: flow_list_extension_custom_tables
title: List an extension's custom tables
